title: Moth Trap New-Species Night Finder
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mothtrap:session
| search new_species_count>0
| stats sum(new_species_count) as new_species_count sum(catch_count) as catch_count by trap_id
| sort 0 - new_species_count
value: Ranking new-species nights helps you learn which conditions produce the most interesting catches.
implementation: Send new-species nights events to `index=personal` and keep `trap_id` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of new-species nights by traps.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which trapss stand out most for new-species nights.
